title: September 2026 CVE Landscape
content_md: In September 2026, Insikt Group® identified 94 high-impact vulnerabilities to prioritize for remediation , 59 of which had a Very Critical Recorded Future Risk Score. This represents a 29% increase from last month. 43 of these vulnerabilities were surfaced through the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)’s Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, 37 were reported in open sources and validated by Insikt Group, and 14 were exclusively surfaced through honeypot data. The 94 vulnerabilities identified affected products from 58 vendors, with Linux and Microsoft together accounting for approximately 13% of the vulnerabilities. The remaining exposures spanned network edge and security management appliances; operating systems (OS) and mobile devices; collaboration, content management, and enterprise platforms; artificial intelligence (AI), developer, and automation tools; and operational technology and industrial systems. September reporting also highlighted zero-day exploitation of CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 (NetScaler), as well as renewed exploitation of CVE-2026-35273 (PeopleSoft) against unpatched systems.
